outcome: Regaining birth weight by 2 weeks of age
cohort: 988 infants with moderately low birth weight (1500g-2499g) in India, Malawi, and Tanzania
finding: Higher week 1 LATCH and PIBBS scores were associated with increased likelihood of regaining birth weight by 2 weeks of age, and higher PIBBS scores at 1 week were associated with improved weight gain velocity, but neither score was associated with exclusive breastfeeding rates.
